##Prework for excercise
```{r}
## Prework for Exercise

# Load required package
library(tseries)

# Load dataset
load("GSPC.RData")

# Inspect column names
colnames(GSPC)

# Extract adjusted closing prices
P <- GSPC[, "GSPC.Adjusted"]

# Remove missing values
P <- na.omit(P)

# Calculate log-returns
r <- 100 * diff(log(P))

# Remove missing values
r <- na.omit(r)

# Display first observations
head(P)
head(r)

# Summary statistics
summary(P)
summary(r)

#extra check!
length(P)
length(r)
```

##Question 1.1: Stationarity Tests

```{r}
# ADF test for adjusted closing prices
adf_price <- adf.test(P)

# ADF test for log-returns
adf_return <- adf.test(r)

# Display results
adf_price
adf_return
```
###Why not run a kpss test too?
```{r}
## KPSS Stationarity Tests

# KPSS test for adjusted closing prices
kpss_price <- kpss.test(P)

# KPSS test for log-returns
kpss_return <- kpss.test(r)

# Display results
kpss_price
kpss_return
```


## Question 1.2
```{r}
# Packages
library(moments)
library(tseries)

# Plot log-returns
plot(r,
     type = "l",
     col = "blue",
     main = "S&P 500 Log-Returns",
     ylab = "Return (%)",
     xlab = "Time")

abline(h = 0, col = "red")

# Skewness and kurtosis
skew_r <- skewness(as.numeric(r))
kurt_r <- kurtosis(as.numeric(r))

cat("Skewness =", skew_r, "\n")
cat("Kurtosis =", kurt_r, "\n")

Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(as.numeric(r), lag = 40, type = "Ljung-Box")

# ACF plot
acf(as.numeric(r),
    main = "ACF of Log-Returns")
```

##1.6
```{r}
library(rugarch)

# 1. Define the model from equations (2)-(4)
spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model     = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model         = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

# 2. Estimate it by maximum likelihood
fit <- ugarchfit(spec = spec, data = r)

# 3. Parameter estimates with robust standard errors
round(fit@fit$robust.matcoef, 4)

# 4. Persistence
persistence <- coef(fit)["alpha1"] + coef(fit)["beta1"]
persistence
```


```{r}
# Standardized residuals (estimate of v_t)
z <- as.numeric(residuals(fit, standardize = TRUE))

# Test 1: autocorrelation in z (is the mean equation OK?)
Box.test(z, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Test 2: autocorrelation in z^2 (is the variance equation OK?)
# fitdf = 2 because 2 parameters (alpha1, beta1) were estimated in the variance
Box.test(z^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 2)

# Test 3: remaining ARCH effects
ArchTest(z, lags = 20)

# Test 4: normality
library(moments)
skewness(z); kurtosis(z)
jarque.bera.test(z)
```

##1.8
```{r}
## Question 1.8

library(rugarch)

# Define GARCH(1,1) with Student-t innovations
spec_t <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(0, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

# Estimate the model
fit_t <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_t, data = r)

# Display parameter estimates with robust standard errors
round(fit_t@fit$robust.matcoef, 4)

# Calculate volatility persistence
persistence_t <- coef(fit_t)["alpha1"] + coef(fit_t)["beta1"]
persistence_t
```
```{r}
# Standardized residuals
z_t <- as.numeric(residuals(fit_t, standardize = TRUE))

# Ljung-Box test on standardized residuals
Box.test(z_t, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box test on squared standardized residuals
Box.test(z_t^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = 2)

# ARCH-LM test
ArchTest(z_t, lags = 20)
```

```{r}
spec_tgarch <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(
    model = "gjrGARCH",
    garchOrder = c(1, 1)
  ),
  mean.model = list(
    armaOrder = c(0, 0),
    include.mean = TRUE
  ),
  distribution.model = "norm"
)

fit_tgarch <- ugarchfit(
  spec = spec_tgarch,
  data = r
)

# Parameter estimates
round(fit_tgarch@fit$robust.matcoef, 4)

# Model fit
likelihood(fit_tgarch)
infocriteria(fit_tgarch)
```

##1.11-13 prework
```{r}
# prework

# Load packages
library(rugarch)
library(rmgarch)

# Load S&P MidCap 400 dataset
mid_objects <- load("~/Desktop/Econ2026/MID.RData")

# Inspect the object loaded from the file
mid_objects

# Extract the dataset
MID <- get(mid_objects[1])

# Identify the adjusted closing price column
mid_col <- grep("Adjusted$", colnames(MID), value = TRUE)

# Check that exactly one column was found
stopifnot(length(mid_col) == 1)

# Extract adjusted closing prices
P_mid <- MID[, mid_col]

# Remove missing values
P_mid <- na.omit(P_mid)

# Calculate log-returns
r_mid <- 100 * diff(log(P_mid))

# Remove missing values
r_mid <- na.omit(r_mid)

# Inspect returns
summary(r_mid)
```
```{r}
# Combine S&P 500 and S&P MidCap 400 returns
returns <- merge(r, r_mid, join = "inner")

# Remove observations with missing values
returns <- na.omit(returns)

# Rename columns
colnames(returns) <- c("SP500", "MID400")

# Inspect combined dataset
head(returns)
tail(returns)

# Check dimensions
dim(returns)

# Check sample period
start(returns)
```
## 1.11
```{r}

# Use the GARCH(1,1) specification from Question 1.6
multi_spec <- multispec(list(spec, spec))

# Specify DCC(1,1)
dcc_spec <- dccspec(
  uspec = multi_spec,
  dccOrder = c(1, 1),
  model = "DCC",
  distribution = "mvnorm"
)

# Estimate the DCC(1,1) model
dcc_fit <- dccfit(
  spec = dcc_spec,
  data = returns
)

# Display estimation results
dcc_fit
```

# Question 1.12
```{r}
# Extract time-varying conditional correlation matrices
dcc_cor <- rcor(dcc_fit)

# Extract correlation between S&P 500 and MidCap 400
rho <- dcc_cor[1, 2, ]

# Summary statistics
summary(rho)
```
```{r}
# Convert dates to Date format
dates <- as.Date(names(rho))

# Plot conditional correlations
plot(
  dates, as.numeric(rho),
  type = "l",
  main = "DCC(1,1) Conditional Correlation",
  xlab = "Date",
  ylab = "Conditional correlation",
  col = "blue"
)
```
```{r}
# Find the lowest estimated correlation
min(rho)
 
# Find the date it occurred
names(rho)[which.min(rho)]
```


##1.13
```{r}
dcc_forecast <- dccforecast(dcc_fit, n.ahead = 1)

H_forecast <- rcov(dcc_forecast)[[1]][, , 1]
H_forecast
```
```{r}
# Minimum-variance weight for the S&P 500
w1 <- (H_forecast[2,2] - H_forecast[1,2]) /
      (H_forecast[1,1] + H_forecast[2,2] - 2*H_forecast[1,2])

# Weight for the S&P MidCap 400
w2 <- 1 - w1

# Display the weights
c(SP500 = w1, MID400 = w2)
```
```{r}
# Forecasted variance of the minimum-variance portfolio
portfolio_variance <- w1^2 * H_forecast[1,1] +
                      w2^2 * H_forecast[2,2] +
                      2 * w1 * w2 * H_forecast[1,2]

portfolio_variance
```
```{r}
# Extract estimated conditional means
mu <- coef(dcc_fit)[c("[SP500].mu", "[MID400].mu")]

# Forecasted portfolio return
portfolio_return <- w1 * mu[1] + w2 * mu[2]

portfolio_return
```
